verses.original: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּֽעֲל֗וֹת לִשְׁלֹ֫מֹ֥ה אִם־ יְהוָ֤ה׀ לֹא־ יִבְנֶ֬ה בַ֗יִת שָׁ֤וְא׀ עָמְל֣וּ בוֹנָ֣יו בּ֑וֹ אִם־ יְהוָ֥ה לֹֽא־ יִשְׁמָר־ עִ֝֗יר שָׁ֤וְא׀ שָׁקַ֬ד שׁוֹמֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: šîr ham·ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ liš·lō·mōh ’im- Yah·weh lō- yiḇ·neh ḇa·yiṯ šāw ‘ā·mə·lū ḇō·w·nāw bōw ’im- Yah·weh lō- yiš·mār- ‘îr šāw šā·qaḏ šō·w·mêr
verses.literal: A song of ascents Of Solomon Unless . . . the LORD builds the house its builders labor in vain unless . . . the LORD protects the city its watchmen stand guard in vain
verses.literalPt: SE o SENHOR não edificar a casa, em vão trabalham os que a edificam; se o SENHOR não guardar a cidade, em vão vigia a sentinela.

verses.original: שָׁ֤וְא לָכֶ֨ם׀ מַשְׁכִּ֪ימֵי ק֡וּם מְאַֽחֲרֵי־ שֶׁ֗בֶת אֹ֭כְלֵי לֶ֣חֶם הָעֲצָבִ֑ים כֵּ֤ן יִתֵּ֖ן לִֽידִיד֣וֹ שֵׁנָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: šāw lā·ḵem maš·kî·mê qūm mə·’a·ḥă·rê- še·ḇeṯ ’ō·ḵə·lê le·ḥem hā·‘ă·ṣā·ḇîm kên yit·tên lî·ḏî·ḏōw šê·nā
verses.literal: In vain you rise early and stay up late toiling for bread to eat for He gives sleep to His beloved
verses.literalPt: Inútil vos será levantar de madrugada, repousar tarde, comer o pão de dores, pois assim dá ele aos seus amados o sono.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה נַחֲלַ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה בָּנִ֑ים שָׂ֝כָ֗ר פְּרִ֣י הַבָּֽטֶן׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh na·ḥă·laṯ Yah·weh bā·nîm śā·k̲ār pə·rî hab·bā·ṭen
verses.literal: Children are indeed a heritage from the LORD and the fruit of the womb is His reward
verses.literalPt: Eis que os filhos são herança do SENHOR, e o fruto do ventre o seu galardão.

verses.original: כְּחִצִּ֥ים בְּיַד־ גִּבּ֑וֹר כֵּ֝֗ן בְּנֵ֣י הַנְּעוּרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ḥiṣ·ṣîm bə·yaḏ- gib·bō·wr kên bə·nê han·nə·‘ū·rîm
verses.literal: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior so are children born in one’s youth
verses.literalPt: Como flechas na mão de um homem poderoso, assim são os filhos da mocidade.

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֤י הַגֶּ֗בֶר אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִלֵּ֥א אֶת־ אַשְׁפָּת֗וֹ מֵ֫הֶ֥ם לֹֽא־ יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ כִּֽי־ יְדַבְּר֖וּ אֶת־ אוֹיְבִ֣ים בַּשָּֽׁעַר׃
verses.transliteration: ’aš·rê hag·ge·ḇer ’ă·šer mil·lê ’eṯ- ’aš·pā·ṯōw mê·hem lō- yê·ḇō·šū kî- yə·ḏab·bə·rū ’eṯ- ’ō·wy·ḇîm baš·šā·‘ar
verses.literal: Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them He will not be put to shame when he confronts the enemies at the gate
verses.literalPt: Bem-aventurado o homem que enche deles a sua aljava; não serão confundidos, mas falarão com os seus inimigos à porta.
